sources.description: June 17, 2015 - Comprehensive analysis of the 55-year US embargo on Cuba, including economic impact estimates of $1.1 trillion.
sources.label: Al Jazeera - El Bloqueo: 55 Years of Obstructing the Cuban People

sources.description: May 9, 2018 - Reports UN ECLAC estimate that embargo has cost Cuba $130 billion over nearly six decades.
sources.label: Reuters - U.S. Trade Embargo Has Cost Cuba $130 Billion, U.N. Says

sources.description: November 1, 2023 - UN General Assembly press release on Cuba embargo resolution; reports $4.87 billion in damages from 2022-2023.
sources.label: UN Press Release - GA12552

sources.description: September 30, 2025 - Reports new Cuban government assessment: $170.7 billion in damages, $2.1 trillion with inflation.
sources.label: People's World - New Cuban Report Confirms U.S. Blockade Is War

sources.description: February 2, 2022 - Declassified documents on the origins and evolution of US economic sanctions against Cuba.
sources.label: National Security Archive - Cuba Embargoed: U.S. Trade Sanctions Turn Sixty

sources.description: 1997 - Comprehensive study finding the embargo contributed to malnutrition, poor water access, and lack of medicine in Cuba.
sources.label: American Association for World Health - 1997 Report on U.S. Embargo Impact

sources.description: UN background documentation on the annual General Assembly resolution condemning the US embargo.
sources.label: UN General Assembly - Necessity of Ending the Embargo Imposed by USA Against Cuba

sources.description: Energy data firm reporting Cuba had 15-20 days of oil reserves after US fuel blockade began in January 2026.
sources.label: Kpler - Cuba Oil Supply Data (January 2026)

sources.description: February 2026 - UN special procedures condemn Trump's fuel blockade as 'serious violation of international law.'
sources.label: UN Experts - February 2026 Statement on Cuba Fuel Blockade
